column1: # The files are TRACKED in this repository; this manifest is the record of where
# each came from and whether it was changed, not a build input that reaches
# outside the checkout.  tools/doom/verify-sources.sh checks the tracked tree
# against the local columns and needs nothing but this checkout.  The original
# columns let a reviewer re-derive the same digests from the source revision;
# tools/doom/audit-origin.sh does that when a read-only predecessor checkout is
# supplied, and is an audit, never part of build or test.
# The computed set is the require_relative closure of the three entry points and
# the five IWAD-independent probes.  The union of the three entry closures is 34
# files, matching docs/doom/task1-checkpoint.md; the probe closure adds
# palette.rb, picture.rb and the probe programs, and each probe's
# The GPU raster port (2026-09-23, tools/raster) adds three more entry-kind
# programs: bin/dump_jobs.rb, bin/gpu_demo.rb and bin/gpu_reject.rb. Their
# originals are identical at f8ad13c6 and at the port's source revision
# 463d49dd, so their original columns stay on this manifest's one revision.
# Their require_relative closures add no library file.
# The GC-monitoring port (2026-09-23, tools/gcmon) adds bin/bench_tic.rb, the
# subject of tools/gcmon/run_gcmon_gate.sh. Its original is identical at
# f8ad13c6 and at 463d49dd, and its closure adds no library file.
# The leftovers port (2026-09-23) adds bin/dump_ppm.rb, which writes WAD
# pictures as PPM for looking at, and the library file it needs, lib/doom/ppm.rb;
# both originals are identical at f8ad13c6 and 463d49dd. It also adds
# bin/frame_ppm.rb, written here (kind=local), which writes a frame that
# modified=yes marks an imported file whose local bytes differ from its
# original's.  Fifty-one are: the five test programs, changed ON import and
# only in their require_relative prefixes (tests/doom/NOTICE.md); the two input
# scripts and wad_and_picture.expected, whose Japanese comments and printed
# remarks were translated into English on 2026-11-23; and all 43
# imported files under examples/doom, changed AFTER it.  Seven of those have
# statusbar.rb, render_gpu.rb, executor.rb and jobs.rb -- and on 2026-11-23 the
# Japanese comments of all 43 were translated into English, comments only
# kind=local marks a file written HERE rather than imported.  Its original
# columns are "-" and modified is "n/a", because there is no original.  These
# rows exist so the manifest covers every file in the imported directories: a
# file that is simply absent from the manifest would otherwise be a hole in the
# bijection, and "is this ours or theirs?" would be answered by looking at the
# header comment instead of by the record.
